# themes fixtures

Original, hand-authored `.theme` files exercising task group 9's closed
theme schema: `academic.theme` (conventional, no furniture) and
`magalu.theme` (a clearly unofficial demonstration theme with a watermark
and a logo). `assets/logo.png` is an original, redistributable 200x60 solid
placeholder image generated for this fixture — it carries no real corporate
branding, private font, or credential, matching the "Portable font and
asset selection" requirement (`test_public_theme_has_no_private_dependencies`,
`test_logo_resolves_from_theme_directory`).
